snippet.title: Mousement - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Mousement is now Available on Itch.io: https://flammed-studios.itch.io/mousement

About Mousement:
Mousement is a simple Game, your Quest is it to move the Red Block by using your Mouse to reach the Finish while avoiding Surikanes and not falling down.

Follow Flammed-Studios on X: https://x.com/FlammedStudios
